distinctiveFeatures.description: An ornate, raised-looking decorative motif adorns the chest.
Decorative round buttons run down the center front.
The sleeves are rolled to wide cuffs below the elbows.

visualDescription: A taupe-brown, solid, hip-length bandi shirt with a smooth, slightly lustrous appearance and a straight structured silhouette. It has a stand band collar, a center-front row of decorative buttons, rolled three-quarter sleeves with wide cuffs, two lower-front welt pockets, and an ornate chest embellishment.
